newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline up $9 on bullish cocktail.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline up $9 on bullish cocktail.

text.p: NWE gasoline shot up $9.00 a tonne on Thursday as bouyant U.S. futures, problems at a U.S. cat cracker, tight European supplies and news Nigeria is to extend gasoline imports combined with physical trades to smother the market with bullish sentiment.
Eurograde barges traded at $227, $229 and $230 with one trader dominating the buying. A 10,000 tonne cargo was sold around $217 fob for loading next week to the same trader.

Dealers said the market was stronger on the back of the U.S., which was pulling cargoes trans-atlantic, tight supplies in the Mediterranean and the likelihood of rewewed gasoline importing by Nigeria. But some in the market thought the hike was overdone.

"Prices are higher because they reflect a real tightness, real demand and real backwardation but whether by the amounts we are seeing is debatable...there is some leveraging going on against big swaps positions," said one trader.
"It appears to be a select band who are buying," said another dealer.
U.S. demand for gasoline and recent high prices has drawn up to 150,000 tonnes of European material since the middle of last week, traders estimate.
